name: booking-platform
description: WhatsApp-first booking platform: Expo app (apps/mobile), Hono API (apps/backend), Supabase (supabase/)

scripts.check:mobile: npm run lint -w apps/mobile && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile && npm run test:no-watch -w apps/mobile && npm run lint -w packages/ui && npm run typecheck -w packages/ui
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/backend test && npm --prefix apps/backend run check:edge && npm --prefix apps/backend run test:edge
scripts.check: npm run check:mobile && npm run check:backend
